question: Can the existing Treatment Line consume a bounded LIFO reaction chain with cast-time resource commitment while preserving classic combat and exact final contact/DOT ownership?
source_contracts: STK-001: chosen action enters stack and opens reaction window
CST-001: cast cost remains spent even when countered
original_policy: Optional response practice only: commit is 48 base physical weapon damage affected by existing burn, paid by one shared treatment charge before queuing. The target has one ward reserve. Release resolves ward before commit; break-ward costs one further shared charge and resolves before ward. Full chain consumes one existing round/contact/DOT, not one round per stack item. Classic free actions stay unchanged.
acceptance: Commit cost occurs before pending observation; HP, enemy HP, round and effects do not advance until actual release/counter resolution.
LIFO counter neutralizes actual ward before actual commit; release retains paid cost but deals zero through resolved ward.
Malformed, unknown, unavailable and wrong-phase actions cannot supply effects or extra resources.
Pending window cannot substitute unrelated action or passive swap; reads/redraw/time cannot resolve or refund.
Current global-round DOT and terminal ordering stay owned by Trial after chain.
At least two actual policies, including a losing or exhausted choice, retain exact traces without balance/population claims.
Original classic controls and source vectors reexecute unchanged.
False result and visible pending-as-hit/refund renderer controls are rejected.
limits: Bounded software contract adaptation from preserved requirements, not full stack/initiative/trigger-slot system, complete Ruby/RMXP execution, trained AI, Commander game, human balance/canon, Unity/Windows/Steam or durable world.
timing_disclosure: Draft before current implementation outcomes. Specialist analyses requested independently; actual availability and influence must be reported, not assumed.
